correctness.rationale: Exact Bernoulli cut bijection and finite inclusion-exclusion identify F_{n,r}(p); the Bernoulli score identity gives exact covariance. For r near log2 n, factorially dominated differentiated IE gives 2x exp(-x). Local pivotality plus a disjoint run-free segment provides two-sided summable uniform tails for the full derivative sum. Geometric and double-exponential longest-run tails give second-moment convergence to the nondegenerate lattice extreme-value law. The proof covers every n tending to infinity, not an inference from finite enumeration. 45 exact rational threshold/derivative comparisons and three independent published numeric checks pass.
